probes.procedure: As clusterops on each source, connect noninteractively by stable name to both peers with strict host-key checking and return remote identity and hostname; inspect the operations document.
Inspect extra accounts, shared/backup keys, temporary credentials, broad firewall rules, debug artifacts, conflicting SSH settings, duplicate host mappings, and unnecessary services.

assertions.pass_condition: All six directed paths succeed noninteractively as clusterops to the correct stable peer name with strict host-key verification.
assertions.fail_condition: Any properly invoked directed path is confirmed to fail, require interaction/root, relax host-key checking, or reach the wrong identity.

assertions.pass_condition: OPERATIONS.md accurately covers topology, six-path verification, reboot persistence, and interrupted-service recovery.
assertions.fail_condition: The document is absent or materially incomplete/inaccurate for the live implementation.

assertions.pass_condition: Only required account, packages, keys, mappings, SSH configuration, firewall policy, and documentation remain.
assertions.fail_condition: Concrete executor-created extra account/key, broad rule, debug, conflict, or temporary residue remains.
